text: I'd like to say that I'm really impressed with everything. ❤️❤️ I had my teeth scaled and my retainer fitted at Have Fun Dental Clinic, which was recommended by a friend. I don't usually get my teeth scaled very often because I once went to a clinic where the doctor was really rough and hit my gums in several places. He did it really fast and hard, and my teeth were really sensitive. Afterwards, my teeth were sensitive for a day and my mouth was sore. 😓 I was so taken aback and thought that other places would be similar. However, my friend recommended Have Fun, saying that the doctor had a very gentle touch, so I gave it a try. The clinic has enough parking space for customers, and next to it is a cute, minimalist cafe with very delicious drinks, I can confirm. You can sit and wait in the cafe, and the staff at the cafe will call you when it's your turn. The wait isn't that long, but I wanted to have a chill drink first, so I sat and waited at the cafe. The service at the clinic, from the receptionist, the assistant doctor, and the doctor, was beyond my expectations. They were all very friendly and impressed with their service mind. Most importantly, the doctor had a very gentle touch. They kept asking me if it hurt or if it was too hard or if it was okay. You can tell the doctor. And it didn't hurt my gums at all. After scraping, they also applied fluoride for free. My teeth are clean and white. It's worth more than the price. The price is also very friendly and not expensive. I highly recommend this place @have fun dental clinic 💕💕😍😍
